payload.sprintGoal: Complete normative specification synchronization and test authority generalization to achieve full TECHSPEC compliance and production dogfooding readiness.
preconditions: Repository working tree is clean at HEAD 293ef0f192440525840f6d686b2c3e56cd96bba9
All 53 tests passing across 15 test files

include: TECHSPEC v1.3.0 amendment for Skill Architect subsystem
Guard count reconciliation (83 claimed vs 86 implemented)
Dogfooding run through native conversational path

tasks.title: Audit TECHSPEC Drift — Skill Architect Subsystem
tasks.description: Identify all TECHSPEC sections requiring amendment to incorporate agent 0132, SKILL_ARCHITECT role, SKILL_SYNTHESIS workflow state, SkillPackage schema, and skill files.
deliverables: List of TECHSPEC sections requiring updates
acceptanceCriteria: Complete inventory of normative gaps between TECHSPEC v1.3.0 and implementation

tasks.title: Amend TECHSPEC v1.3.0 — Agent Roster
tasks.description: Update agent count from 10 to 11. Add agent 0132 (Inventive Weaver, SKILL_ARCHITECT) to agent roster table and description. Update all references to agent count.

tasks.title: Amend TECHSPEC v1.3.0 — Workflow State
tasks.description: Add SKILL_SYNTHESIS workflow state to state machine documentation. Document transition rules into and out of SKILL_SYNTHESIS state.
acceptanceCriteria: SKILL_SYNTHESIS documented in workflow state enum
Transition rules for skill synthesis documented

tasks.title: Amend TECHSPEC v1.3.0 — Skill Architecture
tasks.description: Document SkillPackage schema, skill synthesis workflow, anti-proliferation guard (>=3 uses), skill capability boundary (skills/**, .pi/skills/**), and bundled role skills.

tasks.title: Amend TECHSPEC v1.3.0 — Natural Pi Integration
tasks.description: Document native Pi integration via before_agent_start and turn_end hooks as primary workflow mechanism (replacing /hitm-run command-only approach).
acceptanceCriteria: Conversational integration described as primary mechanism

tasks.title: Reconcile Guard Count Claim
tasks.description: Verify the actual guard count in Guards.ts. If 86 is correct, update TECHSPEC claim from 83 to 86. Document any discrepancy.

tasks.title: Analyze TestSpecification Authority Defect
tasks.description: Review current TestSpecification payload structure and identify all locations where testFramework and executionCommand are hardcoded or externally supplied instead of sourced from accepted TestSpecification.
acceptanceCriteria: Complete inventory of hardcoded framework/command references

tasks.title: Fix TestSpecification Authority — StateValidation
tasks.description: Update src/domain/project/StateValidation.ts to source testFramework and executionCommand from accepted TestSpecification payload rather than hardcoding 'vitest' and 'npm test'.

tasks.title: Fix TestSpecification Authority — RealDeterministicTestRunner
tasks.description: Update src/infrastructure/testing/RealDeterministicTestRunner.ts to use executionCommand and testFramework from accepted TestSpecification rather than request parameters or hardcoded values.

tasks.title: Fix TestSpecification Authority — TestSuiteHasher
tasks.description: Update src/domain/testing/TestSuiteHasher.ts to ensure canonicalization uses authoritative TestSpecification values for framework and command.
acceptanceCriteria: Hash consistency maintained for existing test suite

tasks.title: Update Test Specification Artifacts
tasks.description: Update existing TestSpecification artifacts and test suite lock to use the corrected authority model with framework and command fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Resume validation works with new model

tasks.title: Run Full Test Suite — Regression Validation
tasks.description: Execute complete test suite to verify no regressions from TestSpecification authority changes. Validate all 53 tests pass.

tasks.title: Commit TECHSPEC Amendments and Test Authority Fix
tasks.description: Commit all TECHSPEC amendments and TestSpecification authority changes with appropriate commit messages.

tasks.title: Dogfooding Run — Native Conversational Path
tasks.description: Perform one complete PiRunner-on-PiRunner dogfooding run through the native Pi conversational integration path (before_agent_start → execution → turn_end → artifact ingestion → transition).
deliverables: Artifact store populated with dogfooding artifacts

risks.risk: TestSpecification authority changes break resume validation
risks.mitigation: Maintain hash consistency; validate with existing test suite lock before and after changes
Cross-reference all amendments against implementation behavior

risks.risk: Dogfooding run uncovers remaining authority defects
risks.mitigation: Document findings as follow-up work items; do not block sprint completion
